answer: Vest rewards slowly. Each epoch's earnings unlock in 12 equal slices over the next 12 epochs, and any account later flagged as a sybil loses every slice not yet unlocked. A 1,000-puppet farm earning 2 tokens per puppet per epoch keeps about 11,000 tokens locked and at risk at all times, so one detection wipes out months of profit. Honest agents only have to wait. Trust grows like cedar, in slow rings that no farm can forge overnight, and no puppet can cash out and slip away to a quiet island.
